hypothesis: HB2+GP's exponential (random-walk) residual extrapolates no local slope past a read metal; a smoother residual kernel (Matern 3/2, 5/2, squared-exponential), chosen per fold by the training likelihood, predicts the adjacent log SF better than HB2+GP on the same reads.
contract: As attempt 2: k+1 metals read by gen20's DOPT_Q, only their differences used; all parameters and the kernel choice (HBK@ML: highest training likelihood) from the outer training cells' curves; nothing tuned on held-out cells.
